newsitem.title: UK: UK GDP rises unrevised 0.8 pct in Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: UK GDP rises unrevised 0.8 pct in Q4 1996.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics issued the following provisional, seasonally adjusted data on Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the fourth quarter of 1996. (Index base 1990, constant prices, previous estimates in brackets)
IMPLIED GDP DEFLATOR AT FACTOR COST
GDP EX OIL AND GAS EXTRACTION (constant prices)
NOTE - market forecast for the second estimate of fourth quarter GDP was +0.8 pct qtr/qtr, 2.6 pct yr/yr -- the same as the original figures published on Jan 27.
The ONS said quarterly growth in total production and construction was the strongest since 1994.
GDP growth over 1996 as a whole was unrevised at 2.3 pct.
Services are also growing strongly particularly in the finance sector and transport and communications.
Business services and finance showed quarterly growth of 1.4 percent and rose 5.1 percent year-on-year.
Quarterly growth in transport and communications was 1.0 percent. Year-on-year growth was 4.1 percent.

Agriculture remained weak,, falling by 7.2 percent in the fourth quarter and 2.1 percent year-on-year. BSE remains a major underlying factor, the ONS said. A particularly good harvest in the third quarter exaggerated the fourth quarter fall.
